data.description: Exact disclaimer: research/educational track record of a quantitative model; not investment advice; not a SEBI-registered research analyst or adviser; past performance does not guarantee future returns.
Major API version (v1). Additions are backwards-compatible within v1.
Schema revision of the files (1.0).
Name of the dataset in the file.
Where the values come from: finvest-api (FinVest public API), tracker (computed here), finvest-api via tracker snapshot.
Required attribution text.
When this file was generated.
The payload.
Yahoo-style symbol as used by FinVest (India ends .NS/.BO).
Company name (FinVest screener).
Sector (FinVest screener).
Model view: INITIATE, ADD (together "long signals"), HOLD, REDUCE, EXIT, AVOID. A statistical label of a model, not a recommendation.
long_signal (INITIATE/ADD), hold, avoid, reduce_exit (REDUCE/EXIT).
Model's confidence in its own view. Not a probability of profit.
conviction x 100 as published by FinVest.
Model's bad-case (10th percentile) return over ~1 month. 0.05 = 5%.
Model's median return over ~1 month.
Model's good-case (90th percentile) return over ~1 month.
Average loss in the worst 5% of the model's simulated outcomes (negative).
Model's label for the stock's current mood (e.g. recovery, accumulation, distribution, markdown, panic).
Model's label for the overall market mood.
Last price in FinVest's data at generation (INR for IN, USD for US).
Date of that last price (may lag the as_of_date).
FinVest run date stamped on the signal day.
FinVest's data-quality label.
Tracker flags, e.g. non_equity_id, no_price_history, no_recent_price.
FinVest's text for the view (codes such as momentum_20d, below_sma20 are model features).
When the tracker fetched the snapshot (immutable).
Number of stocks per intent in the full snapshot (including withheld long signals).
true once the day's entry price is locked and its long-signal names are published; false while they are withheld (only the count is given).
How many long-signal names are not yet published.
Entry-session close + 45 minutes; long-signal names appear in the next daily publish after this time.
Session whose price is the tradeable entry for the day (India: close of the observing session; US: next open).

long_positions.json: one object per long signal (INITIATE/ADD) of an UNLOCKED signal day. tradeable = entry at the first achievable price (India: signal-session close, US: next open); signalopen = theoretical open entry. tracked=false means a newer signal maps to the same entry session (reference only, not in statistics).
open, closed, not_entered (no usable entry price) or untracked (reference only).
Return since entry to the last finished session (or exit). net = gross minus the assumed round-trip cost (cost_round_trip). Open positions are marked to the last close.
Return of each of the 3 comparison indices over exactly the same window (same entry timing).
Position return minus index return (percentage points as a fraction).
Trading sessions elapsed since the entry session.
The model's own ~1-month (21 sessions) bad/typical/good-case range on its signal day, to compare with the return so far (range_position).
Adjusted closes of the stock and the 3 indices from 5 sessions before the signal date (chart data; Yahoo-sourced, only with INCLUDE_YAHOO).
Signal days whose long names are still withheld: count (n_long_signals) and unlock_ist only.
Stock move over 1, 5, 21, 63 sessions to the latest finished session (computed by the tracker from adjusted closes; no price series published).
Move since the close of the signal date; null until a session after it has closed.
Same windows for the three comparison indices (India: NIFTY 500 / NIFTY 50 / NIFTY Next 50; US: SPY / QQQ / RSP).
Stock move minus index move per window per index (0.02 = 2 percentage points).
beat (>= +2 pts), inline (within 2 pts), lagged (rose but >= 2 pts behind), fell (fell and >= 2 pts behind), per index. Window in verdict_window.
Average stock move of the group over window w (d1, w1, m1, m3, sn).
Share of the group whose price fell.
Share that moved less than the index.
Share that trailed the index by 2+ points.
Number of stocks per conviction decile (0-10%, ... 90-100%).
Per-ticker: one row per recorded signal day: [as_of_date, intent, conviction, conviction_pct, p10, p50, p90, cvar_95, asset_regime, market_regime, last_price, price_date, data_quality, flags].
Columnar tables (signals/<date>/<market>.json): `columns` names the positions in each row.
FinVest screener fields (pe_trailing, market_cap, roe, ret_3m, rsi14, ...; percent fields are in percent as served by FinVest).
FinVest's insider filings / corporate announcements that mention the ticker (latest 25).
Tracker results: Book A (signal portfolio), Book B (daily list), KPIs, closed/open trades, signal quality, vs the three indices. Empty until the first signal day is locked.
When long signals become visible / first since-signal results exist.
FinVest endpoints that could not be fetched in the last run, with reason.
FinVest endpoint patterns deliberately not collected, with reason.
